text: This solution, Upgrade of the National Disaster Centre’s Information Management System (IMS) addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between National Disaster Centre (NDC), National Weather Service (NWS), Port Moresby Geophysical Observatory (PMGO), Department of Community Development and Religion, Department of National Education, Department of Information, Communication and Technology (DICT), Pacific Community (SPC), Geoscience, Energy and Maritime (GEM) Division, European Union (EU), Organisation of African, and Caribbean and Pacific States (OACPS). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and raising awareness.
